final.view: Portrait photo (1856x4096), oblique front-left view from slightly above. Main block of green plastic cross-stacked trays: front corner stack A seen on its front and right side faces, stack B directly behind A (only its top shows), stack C to the right seen on its front and right side faces with a row receding behind it. A left background block recedes to the right-back: S1-S4 with empty covers, then two uncovered stacks S5 and S6 whose lower parts are hidden by stacks A and B. Backlit, slightly soft.

stacks.note: S1, leftmost stack of the left background block, its left side cut by the frame edge. Both counters: one empty cover (rim y~0.31), then 15 filled layers to the floor at y~0.60, read along a narrow strip at x~0.08-0.10. Copied.

S2, next stack of the left block, seen more obliquely; lower half in deep shadow and its right part hidden behind stack A below y~0.43. Both counters: one empty cover (rim y~0.305) and 15 filled layers to the floor at y~0.57. Copied (A low, B medium).

S3, left block, between S2 and S4 (seam with S4 at x~0.372 where the cover cones step and the band parity flips). Empty cover (rim y~0.30), then 7 visible filled layers down to y~0.41 where stack A's cover and stack B hide the rest. Visible layers only. Copied.

Stack A, the front corner stack: front face x 0.22-0.445, right side face to ~0.54. Empty cover (rim y~0.437), then 17 filled layers alternating 5/6-egg rows to the floor at y~0.75. Both counters 17+1 by two methods; my calibration crop of its top confirmed the cover and the big-egg first layer directly under the cover rim. Copied.

S4, left block, right of S3 (seam x~0.372); its right end at x~0.445 is a dark gap before S5. Listed only by A; B mentioned these background stacks in its notes but did not list them. Exists and is countable. Recounted at 0.005-tick zoom along x 0.38-0.43: top band y 0.286-0.300 is an empty cover (pointed dividers with the wall visible between them, base rim 0.300). Layer 1 y 0.300-0.312: dark small-hole face with faint egg ovals. Layer 2 y 0.312-0.327: big-hole face, 5 eggs plus a sixth at the oblique right end. Layer 3 y 0.327-0.340: dark small-hole face, visible almost to its base rim before stack B's cover cones hide everything from y~0.338-0.342. Pitch ~0.0135. Rim pass and egg-row pass both give 3 filled + 1 cover; the third layer's base rim is hidden, so visible layers only.

Stack B, directly behind A and level with C. Only its top shows: empty cover (rim y~0.358-0.36), then 3 filled layers (5, 6, 5 eggs) to y~0.41, below which stack A hides it. Visible layers only. Copied (A medium, B low).

S5, stack right of S4 (dark seam at x~0.445), front face receding to the right like the rest of the left block. Listed only by A. Exists and is countable. Recounted at 0.005-tick zoom: no cover, egg tops exposed in two or three rows (y 0.285-0.300) sitting directly on the top band y 0.298-0.307, which is the small-hole face of a filled tray (dark cups with ribs), base rim 0.307. Layer 2 y 0.307-0.319: big-hole face, 6 eggs counted at x 0.456-0.503. Layer 3 y 0.319-0.331: dark small-hole face, visible to the line where stack B's cover cones begin (y~0.331-0.333), so its base rim is just hidden. Pitch ~0.012. Visible layers only; the rest is behind B. 3 filled, 0 cover.

S6, a separate stack right of S5, listed only by A. Exists and is countable. Separate because at the seam x~0.51 there is a vertical corner post, the top rim steps up by one rim thickness (S5 0.307, S6 0.304), the band types are opposite at the same heights, and the face slope is steeper (0.125 vs 0.08), i.e. the next stack along the receding row set back ~15 cm; S5's front recedes to the right so its own right side cannot face the camera, and the 6-egg row (S5 layer 2) and 5-egg row (S6 layer 3) at different levels rule out one cross-stacked corner stack. Top band y 0.2945-0.304 is the big-hole face of a FILLED tray: pointed dividers with white egg between every pair and egg tops in rows above (y 0.285-0.30), the same size and height as S5's exposed eggs, ending at the stack's right edge x~0.558 with only wall beyond; an empty cover shows wall between the dividers (compare S4's cover). So no cover. Layer 2 y 0.304-0.3195: dark small-hole face. Layer 3 y 0.3195-0.331: big-hole face, 5 eggs at x 0.515-0.556; its base rim is hidden by B's cover cones from y~0.331. Pitch ~0.0135. Visible layers only. 3 filled, 0 cover. If the top band were read as an empty cover the stack would be 2 filled + 1 cover; I judge that reading wrong for the reasons above.

Stack C, front corner stack of the right block: front face x 0.555-0.78, right side face to the seam at ~0.835. Empty cover (rim y~0.36), then 20 filled layers alternating 6/5-egg rows to the floor at y~0.72. Both counters 20+1 by two methods. Copied.

final.notes: Disputes resolved: the three backlit background stacks above stack B (S4, S5, S6) exist and are countable as visible layers only; A's counts (3+1, 3+0, 3+0) stand after a third count by rim/band reading at 0.005-tick zoom and egg counts of the big-hole rows (S4: 5-6, S5: 6, S6: 5).
